This page is for you

Companion Animal Travel Desk care notes

Traveling with an animal can feel like a lot at first, but the process is meant to stay calm and steady. The Companion Animal Travel Desk helps travelers prepare the basics, and the staff keep the focus on comfort, safety, and clear steps.

Before the trip, the passenger coordinator checks the travel details and confirms what your animal needs for the journey. <<FACT F091>> Bring the usual documents, follow the packing guidance, and keep your pet supplies simple and easy to reach. A soft carrier, a familiar blanket, and a little patience can make the day smoother for everyone.

At the airport, look for the Companion Animal Travel Desk if you need to review your plan or share last minute changes. The team can help you understand where your animal will go, how handoff works, and what to expect before boarding. If your pet is nervous, speak in a calm voice and keep handling gentle and unhurried.

During the flight, the cabin team keeps watch and gives trained attention to traveling animals. They work to maintain a quiet, careful environment and will follow the approved care steps for your pet. If a crew member needs to check something, answer clearly and stay nearby so the process moves along without stress.

On arrival, staff can help with the next part of the journey and point you toward the right support if pickup needs to be escalated. <<FACT F107>> Stay close to your animal, gather your items before leaving the area, and check that everything has been returned to you.

If you are unsure about any step, the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways is ready to help you with the next part of the trip.
